user_input: Convert the existing console Tic-Tac-Toe application to a JavaFX application with minimal changes. Preserve game rules/model behavior, add a small usable UI and appropriate tests, avoid unrelated refactors, and validate. Workspace: C:\Users\1fake\TicTacToeJavaFX. title: Console Tic-Tac-Toe to JavaFX

assessment_snapshot.intro: The workspace contains a small Java application, and the request is to replace console interaction with a minimal JavaFX UI while preserving game behavior:
bullets: Recon found approximately 690 Java lines and one application module under demo/.
The requested target framework is JavaFX; the existing JDK/build configuration and any graphical design references have not yet been inspected.
The project is a Git repository; implementation scope is limited to the UI conversion, appropriate tests, and validation.

proposed_outcome: Keep the current game model and rules, introduce a small usable JavaFX interface using minimal dependencies, add tests for preserved behavior, avoid unrelated refactors, and validate the resulting project.
